Seek new defects within the documented trusted-coordinator boundary; do not claim cryptographic service or OS attestation.

Do not infer authentication against a trusted coordinator maliciously replacing all records and anchors. Verify the full issue dependency closure precedes individual release projection; each downstream repair still requires its own exact review, including preexisting repairs and multi-issue invalidation. The new regression and all earlier obligations must continue to hold. Reproduce CL7: two declared upstream hashes at one canonical path must not collapse to one review input. Recheck both new registration and already stored legacy revisions. Also check collisions with other required review inputs; no dictionary overwrite may remove required evidence. Identical duplicate references may be deduplicated. Preserve existing valid unique-dependency contracts and immutable historical bytes.
